digest.component_or_area: LLM model class system and configuration
propositions: Rebar LLM model selection uses a single scalar REBAR_LLM_MODEL that cannot express per-pass tier mapping, causing silent fallback downgrades to stop applying when non-default providers like Bedrock are used

Three call paths (step resolution, ladder expansion, verifier path) bypass centralized model routing and must each independently resolve reserved class names (trivial/standard/frontier) to prevent unresolved class strings reaching providers

Configuration layering for LLM classes requires deep recursive merge of tables and wholesale array replacement for fallback chains to allow environment overrides of single keys without forcing restatement of entire class slots
Model class names must be reserved values in the existing model-string YAML space rather than new schema keys to avoid forking step schema and maintain backward compatibility with existing workflows

Deep merge of LLM config tables must be isolated within the llm config resolver and not applied to the shared read_reserved_section helper to avoid silently altering layering semantics for unrelated config consumers
